runtime.title: Runtime status
runtime.note: This page shows the process lifecycle. Check logs for platform login, live connections and messages; use the browser page for browser status.
runtime.description.stopped: No chat process is running. Choose platforms in startup settings.
runtime.description.starting: The server accepted the request and is waiting for the process to start.
runtime.description.running: The process has started. Check logs for platform initialization and connections.
runtime.description.stopping: Stop requested. Waiting for the process to finish cleanup.
runtime.description.failed: The process failed to start or exited unexpectedly. Check logs for details.
runtime.delayed: The process has not exited after 15 seconds. Check logs for details.
browser.title: TTW dedicated browser
browser.intro: Sign in to TikTok in a dedicated Chrome / Edge window. Your profile is retained across server restarts.
browser.note: A connection only means the browser is reachable. Check sign-in or verification in the browser window. You can minimize it to the taskbar; closing it disconnects the browser. The console does not close it automatically.
browser.connected: Browser connected · Check sign-in in the window
error.BROWSER_OPERATION_FAILED: Browser operation failed. Check settings or server logs
error.BROWSER_NOT_FOUND: Chrome / Edge not found. Set BROWSER_EXECUTABLE to its full path
error.BROWSER_START_TIMEOUT: Browser startup timed out. Check the profile lock and debugging port
error.TAB_CLOSED: The tab was closed. Refresh the page
runtime.optionsNote: Select platforms or features. Leave accounts blank to use existing settings. Choices are saved in this browser.
error.RUNTIME_BUSY: The process is already active or stopping
error.INVALID_START_OPTIONS: Check startup options and select at least one platform or feature
runtime.transportNote: Socket: message relay; Bark: push notifications.
runtime.resourcesNote: Samples the chat process every 2 seconds, excluding the server and browser. CPU 100% equals one core; samples older than 10 seconds show —.
